entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
***************
02. 12.11.2014 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

A statement has been made in the present application in furtherance to the observation made by the High Court in Cr. Misc. No. 33254 of 2013 on 30th of September, 2013 that the petitioner filed a surrender petition and prayed for release on bail as offence charged under Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 are bailable in nature, but the Court below has refused to pass any order and returned the application.
In view of above, the Court below is directed now to accept the application of the petitioner and enlarge him on bail preferably on the date on which the application is filed, since the offence which he has been charged are bailable in nature, which is in connection with Brahmpura P. S. Case No.
114 of 2013, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffarpur.

entities.text:
Brahmpura P. S. Case No.

sentences.text: This application is disposed off with above direction upon the court below.
